format: SQLite content-addressed raw bytes + per-input JSON manifest
dedup: only identical SHA256 and length; no path/repo/focal substitution
source_type: historical pipeline-prepared source, not certified pristine Git
exclusions: exact census exclusion list; target/build/tool metadata excluded, nested src paths retained
settings: capture historical sandbox settings.xml separately when present; keep private
resume: no automatic resume; partial evidence retained
